images.name: cover
images.title: An *AI Receptionist* for a dental office
images.sub: Recalls, confirmations, new patient intake and after-hours calls, and what stays with your team.

images.name: duties
images.title: The clinic front desk, *duty by duty*
rows: Confirms tomorrow's schedule, handles replies and fills open slots from the short-notice list.
Works the overdue list every day, offers open times and follows up with patients who don't answer.
Asks the intake questions, books the right visit type and chases forms that aren't back.
Answers when the desk is busy or closed, from the clinic's own information.
Shares published fees, then passes the conversation to the treatment coordinator.
Gives the clinic's written instructions and alerts the on-call person right away.

images.name: day-on-shift
images.title: A day at a *dental office*
rows: A hygiene patient cancels by text. It offers the 9 am slot to the short-notice list and fills it.
Both lines are busy. It takes the overflow and books two new patient exams.
Sends recall texts to 25 overdue patients with open times this week and next.
A patient calls with swelling after an extraction. It gives the written instructions and alerts the dentist.
A patient asks what insurance will cover on a crown. It books a call with the treatment coordinator.
Sends tomorrow's confirmations and moves three appointments when patients reply.
A patient says their claim was denied. It collects the details for billing.
Answers an after-hours call about parking and books a cleaning for next week.

images.name: setup
images.title: How an AI Receptionist *is set up* at a clinic
steps: A business associate agreement in the US, or your country's equivalent, before any patient data.
Tally a week of calls by type and write the booking rules for each visit and provider.
Schedule, contact and insurance fields. No charts, notes or X-rays.
Pain, clinical questions, money and upset patients go to a named person.
It drafts while the office manager reads the log, then takes on more.
Update it when providers, hours or insurance networks change.
